fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestRunInfoAcceptsAndQuestions' passes with a session-less passed question printing '— decision <handle>' and no 'not yet delivered', and its JSON having no session field; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/describe-golden' passes with the golden regenerated. Failure case: a session's passed question not yet delivered still prints ', not yet delivered' and carries its session.
fields.must_not: Change how or when the engine delivers answers, the arbitrated or answered journal entries, or any other run status section.
fields.statement: rhiza run status prints a passed ruling on a question no session asked as '— decision <handle>' without ', not yet delivered', which stays only for a session's question whose answer the engine has not delivered; RunQuestion carries the asking session in an omitempty session field, and in an omitempty change field the change set its asked entry journals (where the question and its Decision live), which the plan reviser reads to apply a ruling.
